title: UI: Stage grid snap and snap-to-guides interaction
description: Unit/integration tests for the snap-to-grid and snap-to-guides behavior in the authoring UI. The engine snapPointToGrid(x, y, gridWidth, gridHeight) and snapPointToGuides(x, y, guides, threshold) functions should already exist or need creating in packages/core/src/engine/snap.ts. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/snap.test.ts.
